The '''26th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2015 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2014, were held at the [[The Century Plaza Hotel|Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]] on January 24, 2015.<ref name="dates">{{cite news|title=PGA Awards Sets 2015 Timeline|url=https://deadline.com/2014/04/pga-awards-producers-guild-2015-deadlines-submissions-717514/|access-date=June 4, 2014|website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|date=April 21, 2014}}</ref> The nominations for documentary film, television, and digital categories were announced on December 1, 2014.<ref>{{cite news|title=Documentary Motion Picture, TV Series/Specials and Digital Series
